UNIVERSITY   OF  VOCATIONAL   TECHNOLOGY   ACT,  No.  31  OF  2008
BY virtue of  the powers vested in me by Section 8(1)(b) of the University of Vocational Technology Act, No. 31 of 2008,
I, Bandula Gunawardana, Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation, on being satisfied that the administration
of the affairs of the University of Vocational Technology, Sri Lanka, have been seriously dislocated and that the authorities
of  the  said  University  have  failed  to  restore  normal  conditions,  do  by  this  Order,  appoint  Senior  Professor  Wachcha
Patabendege  Ranjith  Premalal  de  Silva  to  be  the  Competent Authority  with  effect  from  December  18,  2019  for  the
purpose of exercising, peforming and discharging in lieu of the Vice-Chancellor of the University of Vocational Technology,
Sri Lanka, any power, duty or function respectively which has been conferred or imposed on, or assigned to the said Vice-
Chancellor under the said Act, or under any Order, Ordinance, Statute, By-Law, Regulation or Rule made thereunder.
